visual_action: A wide shot of a political rally. A performer is on stage in front of a large, dense crowd of supporters who are holding up their phones to record. Behind the stage is a large red banner that says "vote" and has the Harris/Walz campaign logo.

cast.name: Flo Milli

cast.name: Kamala Harris

THIS IS YOUR SIGN TO VOTE

spoken_summary: The audio consists of rapper Flo Milli performing her song 'Conceited'. The lyrics are about self-confidence and feeling good about oneself, with lines like "Feelin' myself, I'm conceited."
audio_music: The entire video features the upbeat, high-energy hip-hop track 'Conceited' by Flo Milli, creating a concert-like, hype atmosphere for the political rally.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static wide shot of the performance with no cuts or camera movement.
cultural_references: The video centrally features a performance by popular rapper Flo Milli of her song 'Conceited'.
central_claim: The Harris/Walz campaign is culturally relevant and exciting, using a celebrity performance to motivate young people to vote.
intended_effect: To energize young voters and associate the Harris/Walz ticket with modern pop culture, excitement, and confidence.
